physicalNotes: Radius 0.26719646 Jupiter radii from Orell-Miquel et al. 2023 (2023A&A...669A..40O), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...669A..40O/abstract): 19,102.4 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius.
